cubs.line: I've seen the lions turn to cubs
stanza: I've seen the lions turn to cubs
And I've seen the hunters turn to prey
The lessons will come again tomorrow
I have seen the lions turn to cubs
And I have seen the hunters turn to prey
The lessons will come again tomorrow
When the historians find us we'll be in our homes
A frozen smile on every face
This must have been a wonderful place

shrubs.line: But I see a tree that's standing high among the shrubs
stanza: But I see a tree that's standing high among the shrubs
So only one hand may rest its palm upon my cheeks
The only one that I'll need
